subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept persisted `announceLastRun` state plus `killed` reconciliation for aborted announce delivery turns, with subagent completion announce handoffs always tool-free across CLI, embedded, and Codex native paths?
rationale: The code path appears correct and well-tested, but it changes stored session recovery behavior and an internal tool boundary that maintainers should explicitly own before merge.

options.title: Accept after rebase and checks
options.body: Resolve the merge conflict, rerun `check-lint`, and land this shape if maintainers accept the stored-session and tool-boundary semantics.

options.title: Request narrower recovery semantics
options.body: Ask the author to adjust the terminal status or marker behavior if `killed` reconciliation is not the desired durable session-state contract.

options.title: Pause for broader queue design
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want #94153's message-queue architecture to own announce recovery instead of this narrower restart repair.

recommendation.title: Accept after rebase and checks
recommendation.body: Resolve the merge conflict, rerun `check-lint`, and land this shape if maintainers accept the stored-session and tool-boundary semantics.
